newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Giordano names China business advisor.
newsitem.headline: Giordano names China business advisor.

text.p: Giordano International Ltd said on Tuesday it had appointed N.M. Rothschild & Sons (Hong Kong) Ltd to advise it on its business in China and related issues.
The casual wear retailer said in a statement that it would make a further announcement as soon as practicable.
Trading in its shares would remain suspended until further notice, it said.
Giordano requested a trading suspension in its shares last Friday. It said it had been reviewing its operations in China and planned to issue an announcement on its position there.
Its shares last traded at HK$5.05.
